messages:
Ana (Account Exec): FYI — Marlin Insurance pressed for a firm commitment on private deployment + KMS + SAML SSO. They want an internal go-live target of 2027-05-15 and have signaled legal/ procurement will escalate if dates slip. Can we align scope today?
Mike (PM): Thanks Ana. We need to be explicit about M1 vs M2. What are their "must-haves" vs "nice-to-haves"?
Ana (Account Exec): Must-haves: private control plane in their VPC, AWS KMS integration for key management, SAML SSO for org admins, model pin + rollback. Nice-to-have: on-prem air-gapped package, multi-KMS support.
Julia (Customer Success): Marlin also reiterated they need an SLO for tail latency — specifically p95 < 250ms for interactive flows. They'll accept a phased SLA if we ship core infra first.
Sandeep (Eng Lead): Quick reality check: Private control plane + SAML + AWS KMS is doable in a quarter if we cut scope on on-prem and multi-KMS. However the latency SLO depends on model choice and quantization; we need perf runs.
Olivia (Design): Admin UX for SAML + KMS onboarding will take a couple of screens + docs. We can ship trimmed UX for M1 (manual steps) and automate later.
Mike (PM): Proposal: split into two deliverables.
- M1 (target 2027-05-15): Private control plane (VPC), AWS KMS integration (single provider), SAML SSO, model pin/rollback, canary rollout support, basic admin docs.
- M2 (target +8w): Multi-KMS, improved automated onboarding flow, on-prem packaging if customer pays for engineering effort.
Sandeep (Eng Lead): Risks: on-prem requires validation across customer infra -> unpredictable. Also model perf for 8k-token workloads will likely need tuning; if they expect p50 < 120ms we should clarify model family and max input lengths.
Ana (Account Exec): They said their initial workload is risk scoring and chat summaries, ~2k token average, spikes to 6k. They expect p95 < 300ms and p50 < 150ms.
Mike (PM): Good — update acceptance criteria. If we commit to M1 by 05/15 we need the following minimal AC. I'll paste a draft AC for signoff.
Sandeep (Eng Lead): Please include rollout plan and fallback policy in AC.
Mike (PM): 
```
Acceptance criteria (M1):
- Private control plane deployable into customer VPC (docs + terraform module)
- AWS KMS integration for encryption of model keys + runtime secrets (initial provider only)
- SAML 2.0 SSO for admin console + role mapping
- Model pinning + rollback path (canary 5% -> 100% within 14 days)
- Observability: token-level cost + latency dashboards for the customer route
- Latency target: p50 < 150ms, p95 < 300ms for 2k median payloads (we'll measure and report)
- Legal/compliance: signed addendum for data controls and KMS usage
- Delivery date: 2027-05-15 for completed M1 rollout to Marlin test org
```
Ana (Account Exec): Marlin asked that we include a penalty clause if SLA not met — they'll negotiate, but SOC2+contract terms likely needed.
Julia (Customer Success): We'll request a beta period with Marlin where we run their traffic in test org for 2 weeks before GA. That reduces risk.
Sandeep (Eng Lead): Action items for engineering: perf runs on their sample workload (deadline 2027-04-15), terraform module skeleton (2027-04-30), prototype KMS integration (2027-04-22).
Olivia (Design): I'll produce minimal onboarding flows and admin screens by 2027-04-29.
Mike (PM): I'll coordinate with legal on the addendum and with sales to confirm contract timelines. Recommend we tell Marlin we can commit to M1 by 2027-05-15 contingent on legal sign-off and access to their sample traffic for perf tuning.
Ana (Account Exec): I'll confirm with Marlin and push for written agreement on the two-phase plan.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: private-controlplane-prototype -> staging at 2027-03-28T15:00Z :white_check_mark:
Sandeep (Eng Lead): One more note — if Marlin insists on on-prem GA instead of private-in-VPC, we should price it as an engineering engagement and push timeline to M2.
Mike (PM): Agreed. OK — let's treat M1 as the committed deliverable. Any objections?
Sandeep (Eng Lead): No objections, just the listed risks.
Julia (Customer Success): No objections.
Olivia (Design): Fine.
Ana (Account Exec): No objections. I'll update Marlin and loop legal.
Mike (PM): Thanks team — I'll post the AC in the roadmap doc and add the milestones to the FYQ2 plan.
Ana (Account Exec): tagging this for the week: @sandeep can you confirm perf run cadence and what data format you need?
Sandeep (Eng Lead): Need sample payloads in NDJSON and 24h trace logs if possible. Deadline as above (2027-04-15).
